physical: Free energy: Gibbs free energy is enthalpy minus temperature times entropy; at fixed temperature and pressure a process is spontaneous when it lowers the free energy. G = H − T × S
reflected_formula: [no partner: free energy G] = [no partner: enthalpy H] − [no partner: temperature T] × Culmination (provisional)
reflected_sentence: The definition keeps its shape: an unnamed usable store equals an unnamed total minus an unnamed hotness multiplied by Culmination; only entropy crosses, as Culmination.
rule_reason: Definition (an equivalence); no costs listed and none caused by resistance; keeps its shape.
interpretation: Culmination is the one frozen word here, and it is subtracted after being multiplied by a term with no partner. The second clause, about what happens on its own, has no frozen words at all.
closing: The rule decided without a judgment call: a definition keeps. The 'spontaneous when it lowers the free energy' clause looks like it wants to say something about Culmination rising, but free energy and temperature have no partners, so I did not build that claim. The provisional status of Culmination is noted; I used the word as the table gives it.
